headline: Is Dell (DELL) Quietly Becoming the Backbone of AI Infrastructure Across Sectors?
summary: In recent days, Texas A&M Engineering Experiment Station announced it selected Dell Technologies to design and build IGNITE, a new AI and high‑performance computing platform that will use Dell PowerRack systems with liquid‑cooled PowerEdge servers and AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs, deployed at an Equinix data center in Dallas. At the same time, Dell’s role as a core technology partner in large AI infrastructure builds like IGNITE and Volta Infra Holdings’ Nvidia‑backed cloud platform highlights...
